values.note: Every site in the loop (basic RV sites and tent sites alike) is $28 a night, Saturday and winter the same. A daily vehicle pass ($10-$12 with Colorado plates, $15-$17 without) or an annual Colorado state parks pass is required on top; CPW's reservation fee is charged per stay.

values.note: Sites 201-248: 38 basic RV sites (one ADA), 40-87 ft gravel pads, 6 of them pull-throughs (237-241 and 203), plus 10 tent sites. Sites 201-210 are on the north shore, 214-248 on the south side.

Waterfront: the stored 'not waterfront' evidence was read at the wrong pin ('Reservoir lies 500m+ north'). The catalog's site coordinates sit 31-228 m from water mapped in OSM (north-shore 201/207HD/208 and south-side 214/248/227 at ~31-41 m), and the old note claimed 'shoreline sites'. Re-run the waterfront gate at the real site locations (contrary-claim rule).

Season conflict: CPW's Winter Campground Closures list 'Nov. 1 ... Bockman & North Michigan', but cpwshop sells and has bookings on sites 201-210 through the winter (Nov 2026-Apr 2027). Ask the park (970-723-8366) whether the north-shore row is the winter loop.

Other drive-in RV campgrounds in State Forest SP (cpwshop parkID 50042): Bockman (51 basic sites, 46-114 ft) = entry 2279; Ranger Lakes (31 electric, 40-60 ft) = entry 2281; North Park (14 full-hookup/electric, 60 ft) = entry 14476. No entry: the 'Primitive Loop' ($18, drive-in gravel back-ins, 30-60 ft) - mostly single sites scattered across ~8 km, but sites 469-483 form a 15-site cluster at ~40.566,-105.988 (40-50 ft, 'RV Site,Trailer Site' category), ~1.4 km north of North Michigan - a possible candidate (closes Oct 1). Mendenhall Loop (6 primitive sites, 20 ft max) is under the 23-ft minimum. Crags is listed separately by CPW (closes Oct 1; not in the cpwshop RV catalog read).
